creator: Alexander Terp
description:
`kan add --parent` and `kan edit --parent` check that the argument resolves, then store it as typed, so a parent can be an alias that stops matching when the parent's title changes. Kan also accepts a card as its own parent, and parent cycles. `kan ready` will read parents, so they have to be reliable.

Design: `docs/design/work-across-boards.md`, section "Parents". This card covers writes from the CLI and the HTTP API and `kan doctor` reporting bad parents. Rewriting existing alias parents is part of the card/4 migration, on this phase's links card.
title: Store parents as card IDs and refuse parent cycles
